ModMetaData.name: Elemental Hearts
ModMetaData.author: Elemental Hearts
ModMetaData.description:
ASCEND. TEACH. EVOLVE.
Elemental Hearts is an intentionally powerful sword-combat and progression mod for humanlike pawns. Manifest bound swords and indestructible armor, chain animated techniques, train disciples and unlock evolved lineages.
14 PLAYABLE FORMS Lightning > Thunderstorm > Thunder Incarnate: electrical shocks, crimson dash chains, then seven grand black/yellow forms, Celestial-tier core strength, a lightning-filled Thunderfall pillar, princely regalia, a white-bladed katana, storm crown and animated lightning back aura. Thunder Step blinks across the map; right-click switches its shared button to free Thunder Travel. Ordinary melee scatters lightning. Lethal techniques scorch and explode nearby scenery; Non-lethal or mod settings disable this. Flame > Azure Flame: thermal sword forms, blue fire and a reactive retreat/rush. Wind > Cyclone: Flow combos, precise footwork and bounded airbound finishers. Water > Glacial: Pressure, frontal parries/counters and a five-second crowd freeze. Earth > Adamant: Resolve, ground stabs, seismic circles and spiked-hill impacts. Lunar > Eclipse: rare moonlit sword forms evolving into six black/crimson techniques. Real eclipses grant Celestial-tier core stats; surrounded combat can call a temporary native eclipse. Celestial: a standalone sovereign with six solar/light techniques, Fake Rainbow, chosen Bestow and free manual world-map Light Travel.
ASCENDANT CODEX Open Ascendants on the bottom toolbar for an owned-pawn roster spanning maps, caravans and Light Travel. Search by name/form/location, filter by stage or element, inspect real kill/day milestones, locate a pawn and start its normal Ascend/Evolve ceremony. Select a squad for Auto Combat On/Off/Non-lethal or animated Transform/Revert; busy and ineligible pawns are safely skipped with a report. Individual skill menus stay unchanged. New Otherworlders retain a saved origin marker through Bestow and outfit changes; older summons can be recognized from their uniform and ISEKAI identity. No combat-role or balance changes are introduced by the Codex.
THUNDER INCARNATE Thunderstorm can Transcend after 300 new mastery kills and 15 days at that stage. An interruptible eight-second coronation grants seven forms, Storm Dominion finishers and Sovereign Thunderfall: a colossal lightning beam and ten-cell AOE. Core x3.2 melee damage, 0.04 incoming damage, rapid recovery and +75 mood match Celestial. Healthy health capacities show Moving 650%, Consciousness 200%, Manipulation 300% and Sight/Hearing 250%. Separate saved counters begin when existing Thunderstorms load this update. Shared automation, Non-lethal, Bestow: Lightning and Codex controls remain supported. Yellow trails follow transformed movement; the crown appears while transformed and drafted. Fat/Hulk sides use slimmer fitted cloaks and corrected head height. Heavenbreaker is now a larger white-bladed katana with a black grip, yellow thunder cracks and a fitted Melee Animation profile. Existing six-slot cooldowns migrate safely to seven skills. God Mode exposes DEV: Transcend-Ready; press Transcend afterward.
THE SEVERED COURT Enemy faction: adult humanlike Oathling disciples, normal Court Knights and five evolved Heralds: Azure, Storm, Frost, Gale and Adamant. Heralds wear one distinctive elite obsidian/ivory outfit, crimson cloak and open-brow faceguard. Each retains its five evolved techniques, sword, stats and combat halo. Ten Court backstories, elemental map-name badges and mixed squads give the order its own identity. Ordinary walking raids begin from day 30; smaller rare Herald squads require day 60 and 8,000 points; maximum-budget forces guarantee a Herald while a surviving base can dispatch one. Squads have at most one commander and sixteen total pawns. Herald’s Writ warns of an assault two days ahead. A Broken Oath offers sanctuary to a disciple, with a warned ordinary pursuit if accepted. Pending stories save safely. Settings control raids, Heralds, stories, badges and one-time existing-world introduction. Fresh Court bases each contain a Herald, two Knights, six Oathlings, a fortified compound and a finite treasury. Dedicated Herald Assault and Stronghold Dossier events connect them to the campaign. Dispatches originate from surviving strongholds; clearing a base prevents its future expeditions. Recruits renounce the Severed Oath and regain normal elemental apparel while retaining powers and swords. Existing worlds choose their saved settlement total through a load-time menu or settings, preserving other settlements and cleared bases. Strongholds have double gates, corner watch posts, gatehouses, lineage-colored ceremonial halls, Court standards, warm braziers and furnished barracks, infirmaries, armories and treasuries. Existing loaded forts receive a safe, one-time interior upgrade; new or regenerated maps use the expanded layout. Herald side faceguards fit over the mouth and chin with native west mirroring. Lunar/Eclipse Court bosses remain planned.
COURT FORTRESSES, RELICS AND EVENTS Every Court settlement, including the native first base, now generates the detailed fortress and its initial nine defenders with one Herald. New worlds use at least five bases. Older saves offer a one-time settlement-count menu before adding sites; settings reopen it. Existing and cleared sites count toward the chosen total, and defeated factions stay defeated. Visited maps retain their existing buildings until regenerated and keep surviving defenders. 10,000-point or larger Court raids guarantee one Herald while commanders are enabled and a surviving unengaged base can dispatch one. Smaller late-game raids retain their rare commander roll. Hostile Court deaths yield matching elemental essence; Heralds also leave crucible sigils. Eight essence, two industrial medicine and one industrial component craft an ordinary serum at a drug lab after Fabrication. Sigils refine into four essence of a chosen ordinary element. Saved claims prevent repeated loot after revival. The Severed Crucible offers crafting materials with an explicit one-day ordinary pursuit. The Herald's Ultimatum demands tribute to cancel a saved two-day Herald assault. Existing writs, dossiers, deserters and redemption remain supported.
PROGRESSION Acquire serum or receive power through teaching/Bestow. Normal Ascendants teach three-second paired lessons; disciples can call their own swords. Ascend unlocks at 50 credited kills and five disciple days. Evolution unlocks at 150 mastery kills and ten Ascendant days. Both use interruptible animated ceremonies. Evolved Bestow grants the matching normal lineage directly. Celestial Bestow opens a menu to choose Flame, Lightning, Water, Wind, Earth or Lunar and toggle whether evolution is immediately unlocked. Then select a conscious humanlike recipient, including prisoners/enemies; their faction and prisoner status remain unchanged. It never grants Celestial. With readiness off, earn the normal evolution requirements; with it on, choose when to press Evolve.
COMBAT AND DAMAGE Normal elements have four combat techniques, their evolutions five, Lunar five, and Eclipse/Celestial six. Use skills manually or choose Auto Combat: On / Off / Non-lethal. New disciples and Ascendants start with automation enabled. Draft transformed player pawns to fight and display auras/halos. The lineage Melee damage stat is a multiplier, not fixed ability damage. Techniques use the current melee profile, their own coefficients and combo bonuses. Eligible physical/elemental injury packets receive the existing shared 20% damage reduction once. For example, a normal lineage's x2 melee stat becomes x1.6 for an otherwise identical eligible physical packet before armor and other modifiers. Health-condition descriptions explain each tier; the README includes the complete damage table.
ALLIED SYNCHRONIZATION Two allied transformed Ascendants striking the same enemy within four seconds and eight clear cells gain brief shared melee/movement bonuses. Flame/Wind strengthens one existing hit, Water/Lightning can discharge, Water repairs ordinary injuries, and Earth shares protection. Celestial and eclipse-empowered Eclipse grant stronger synchronization. Each participant has one shared six-second cooldown. No additional skill-menu commands; enabled by default in mod settings. Adamant uses the standard evolved combat tier, below Eclipse and Celestial.
BOUND GEAR AND PASSIVES Transform/Revert smoothly manifests or stores each kit and restores personal clothing. Downing/death removes projected gear; recovery or revival retains ownership. Evolved outfits use fitted regal silhouettes, native west mirroring and subtle drafted halos. Carrying capacity, caravan contributions, recovery and elemental resistances scale with the lineage. Ascendants resist illness/food poisoning; evolved lineages resist Melee Animation's specific knockout condition.
CELESTIAL AND COURT POLISH Light Travel prepares destinations before departure and lands safely without a second prompt. Right-click for precise arrival or same-map relocation. Shorter solar animations preserve gear and recover through saving/loading; paused requests restore pause afterward. No fuel, distance cost or cooldown. Court Knights and Oathlings use fitted native clothing on custom bodies such as FemaleBB, including north views. Better-trained Court ranks pursue combat actively, support a leader's targets and gain a temporary nonstacking formation bonus with three nearby comrades: 12% damage resistance and 8% faster movement. Breaking the formation, captivity, redemption or disabling tactics removes the benefit. They no longer automatically flee at the first group-loss threshold. Otherworld Calling is available as a manual Celestial utility with optional ISEKAI RPG LEVELING compatibility. Spend exactly 1,000 silver during a three-second doorway ceremony to recruit one permanent human aged 18–24. Men wear fitted boys' gakuran; women wear fitted schoolgirl sailor uniforms. No Fat or Hulk recruits. One powerful ISEKAI identity and two compatible talents arrive with them; elemental powers still require Bestow. The default one-in-game-hour cooldown is adjustable in mod settings. Allowed, visible, reachable ground silver can be used anywhere on the current map without storage or a home area. Saved silver reservations, refunds and paid-arrival recovery prevent duplicate payment or people. Missing ISEKAI disables only Calling. The Bestow menu now has six colored elemental cards, evolution previews and clear mastery/readiness controls. Girls' side uniforms have slimmer fitted profiles.
NPC DISCIPLES New eligible adult humanlike NPCs from other factions have a configurable 20% disciple chance. They use automatic combat and bound gear. Each disciple receives one saved 5% near-death combat awakening roll; success heals ordinary injuries and triggers a shockwave with three seconds of heavy protection.
REQUIREMENTS AND COMPATIBILITY RimWorld 1.6 and Harmony. No DLC required. Melee Animation sword profiles and Search and Destroy support are optional. No Milira or VEF dependency. Effects use bounded pools, cached materials and local target searches. No permanent terrain replacement or uncontrolled projectile spawning. Thunder Incarnate can damage buildings and start native fires with bounded committed scenery blasts; other visual floor effects expire. An actual summoned eclipse changes the local sky and solar conditions.
God Mode exposes DEV: Ascend-Ready and DEV: Evolution-Ready for eligible pawns; developer mode alone does not. Disabling God Mode hides them. These commands unlock the normal Ascend/Evolve action rather than applying it.
See the GitHub README for screenshots, acquisition, the complete roster, controls, progression, damage explanations and compatibility notes.
